title: Law-text captures for a residential building in a commercial overlay (work-order step P2; gap K9): ZR 34-11, 34-111, 34-24, 35-53, 35-63 and every section under it (35-631, 35-632 and any other) - source text only (D-090 R291)
objective: Capture, as source text only, the Article III law text that governs a residential building on a lot where a C1 or C2 commercial overlay is mapped within a Residence District (docs/plans/R6B_RESULTS_CONNECTION_WORK_ORDER_2026-10-06.md, section 4 item 7, section 5 gap K9 and section 8 'Step P1 and step P2'). From the official Zoning Resolution site (zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov), with the capture method and file format of the captures made by task M4-T025 under docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ and the synced copy under services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/, each section WHOLE (every paragraph, list item and table), one file per section: ZR 34-11 (General Provisions); ZR 34-111; ZR 34-24; ZR 35-53; ZR 35-63 (the text of the section itself) and EVERY section numbered under it that the official page shows (35-631, 35-632 and any other: the builder lists them from the page and captures each). The work order and one rule file name '34-24(b)(1)', '35-631(b)' and '35-632(a)': the builder reports, from the official page, whether each named paragraph exists as named, and captures the whole section either way. Every other section or defined term these texts point to (for example ZR 35-62, 36-64, 35-71, 23-41, 23-434, 23-435) is LISTED in the report with the pointing words and whether it is captured; it is not captured by this task. Each capture records the official address, the channel used (the page, and the print/PDF channel as the completeness check where it answers; a disclosed fallback where it does not), the time each request was made, the 'last amended' date shown, the verbatim text and its digests. A capture holds source text only: no rule, no reading of what the text means for a lot, no number derived from it. No existing capture is edited. No rule file, rule engine, register entry, reference case or screen changes, and no value is shown anywhere because of a capture.
business_reason: Gap K9 of the work order: the rules for a commercial overlay are not captured, so on a lot with a recorded overlay (the benchmark lot has a C2-2 overlay) every residential result is withheld until the governing sections are captured and read independently. Step 3 of the owner's eight steps (D-090-R291): check the R6B answers, which needs this text before any missing rule can be resolved. A research helper read five of these pages on 2026-10-07 (docs/research/helper-research/P2_Article_III_Lead_2026-10-07.md; backlog row DB-166): a lead, not a capture; it reports that '34-24(b)(1)' does not exist as named.
